logging/syslog#

Syslog over UDP (RFC 5424).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let logs = SyslogLogs(origin: udp, facility: SyslogFacility.daemon, host: "web-1", application: "shop",
    capacity: 1024, overflow: LogOverflow.drop_oldest, scope: scope);

Description#

Syslog over UDP (RFC 5424).

Records are queued and sent in the background; levels map to severities (critical 2, error 3, warning 4, info 6, debug 7).

object SyslogMessage#

object SyslogMessage does ByteSource

RFC5424 UTC header, microseconds without rounding. The complete structured record is the BOM-marked UTF8 MSG; no newline, truncation or resend is added.
